verdict.rationale: Base44 has a dedicated 'Bring your own agent' page. It lets users connect their own AI coding agent or scripts to an app built in the app editor by attaching to its sandbox, with no local copy of the code needed. GitHub sync, the CLI, and an account-level MCP server back this up as further ways for an external agent to work alongside the built-in AI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that external agents work reliably alongside the built-in builder, and detail on how concurrent edits are coordinated.
